purpose: Applies a climate scenario path (NGFS Phase V orderly/disorderly/hot-house, Fit-for-55 supervisory; reference_version NGFS-Phase-V-2025) to an exposure set, emitting stress-adjusted metrics for a bank/insurer climate-risk file. Scenario paths are versioned reference data, not the suite financial-shock stress parameters.
